largerProvidedProject.mode: Raw/reference/source and saved source-bound candidate hashes verified; not rerun by this reviewer.

sourceReview: The guard validates only typedef name existence; it does not change emitted source TYPE_DECL, TYPE, member, RD or scaffold lowering.
Macro expansion uses the definition-site immutable state and shared65536 budget. Incomplete/budget-failed expansions do not fabricate aliases.

Only one error-free type_definition is accepted after reparse. Sized primitive modifier plus type_identifier (such as unsigned UNKNOWN) is explicitly rejected because tree-sitter accepts this invalid shape.

Plain unresolved typedef bases remain allowed as pinned CDT does; valid primitive, pointer/function aliases retain names. The same helper applies to top-level include state and local expression snapshots.
limits: No complete Joern cast/type coverage is claimed. Full diagnostics (including upstream aggregate/header scaffolding) remain retained.
Whole-v2 and builtin/default/header interactions require the parent final replay; this review does not approve whole-v1.
